column1: # RDR-229 P3.5c (nexus-p2m1x.25): the census groups (object, name_column) whose id disposition Rdr229P35cDispositionSitesTest holds to the gate: every census
# line of one of them, in the files that test names, must read through gate 3 (its source line, or one within three lines, names gate3, byId,
# CollectionIdReads or Gate3). These are the 70 id groups that had no reason at e8c85e177b; the test used to select them by their empty reason, which
# a filled reason would hide, so the set is named here. A group is added when a new id disposition is wholly switched; a group that is not wholly
# switched is both, with a reason.
